settings.heading: What is BPC-157?
settings.definition: BPC-157 (Body Protection Compound-157) is a synthetic pentadecapeptide modeled on a gastric peptide fragment. Nootropix BPC-157 capsules provide a pre-measured 500 mcg oral serving in a 60-count bottle.
settings.scientific_body:
Compound: BPC-157 is a 15-amino-acid peptide studied in preclinical models for nitric-oxide signaling, VEGFR2-Akt-eNOS activity, angiogenesis, and tissue-recovery pathways. Oral capsules offer a practical route for users who prefer a simple daily format over reconstituted peptide vials.

  • Format: 500 mcg oral capsules, 60ct.
  • Verification: BT Lab Testing confirmed the BPC-157 raw material used in this lot by FTIR and HPLC.
  • Storage: room temperature, tightly closed, away from heat and moisture.

Informational only. Not medical advice.
